status: development; October-November 2025 already inspected in project
target: Gross positive recorded units for completed/shipped/returned status, case normalized, assigned to order date. Returns are included without stock credit; negative or zero corrections excluded. Exact duplicate rows removed; conflicting transaction IDs rejected. Processing and cancelled excluded.
target_sensitivity: Repeat fixed comparisons for positive noncancelled orders including processing, and fulfilled nonreturned orders. Descriptive exploratory sensitivities only; do not replace primary target or winner.
missing_dates: Global calendar has transactions on every day. Within each pair after first recorded activity, missing transaction rows on globally represented days mean zero RECORDED target units, a conditional observation convention, not verified no demand or stockout exposure. Before first activity remains missing. Globally absent dates rejected in routine rather than silently imputed.
population: All 336 operational keys; same eligible population for every candidate; every pair observed before evaluation. Use only sales through each origin; no operational snapshots as forecast features.
train: Only dates on/before origin. Baseline last 56 days, pooled candidate last 91 days, Poisson at most last 104 full Monday-Sunday weeks. Training feature history also bounded by origin.
evaluation: 2025-10-06 through 2025-11-30; 7-day primary, 8 through 14-day secondary; overlapping longer horizons are dependent. No December outcomes.

baseline.name: recent_8week
baseline.description: Per-pair recorded daily mean over preceding 56 days; analytical baseline, no incumbent supplied.

candidates.name: recent_8week
candidates.rationale: Transparent local recent rate; enough weeks for sparse series, fair operational baseline.

candidates.name: pooled_13week
candidates.rationale: Shrink 91-day local rate toward product-wide store mean, weight 91/(91+28); borrows strength across sparse stores without heavy modeling.

candidates.name: poisson_calendar
candidates.rationale: Sparse penalized Poisson regression for positive count-like weekly units; pair effects, month effects, bounded time trend and lagged 4/13-week averages capture pooling, seasonal calendar and recent movement. Alpha 0.1, max_iter 200, tolerance 1e-6, no search. Weekly fitting reduces data size; predict daily as weekly conditional mean / 7 with forecast-day month, lag features frozen at origin.

primary_metric.name: MAE_7day
primary_metric.unit: product units per product at store per forecast origin
primary_metric.weighting: Equal weight to each of 336 keys and seven origins; absolute error of horizon TOTAL, not daily errors.

selection_rule: Choose lowest pooled primary MAE. Absolute ties within 1e-9 resolve recent_8week, pooled_13week, poisson_calendar. No business significance threshold invented. Secondary metrics cannot overturn primary rule.
secondary_diagnostics: signed error, WAPE, 8-14 day aggregate MAE
per-origin and store errors; zero observed target frequency
Poisson convergence and CPU time/peak resident memory fit/inference plus preparation
recorded-demand uncertainty using empirical 7-day residual quantiles, descriptive, not guaranteed coverage
ordering_horizon: Score all supported 8-14 day lengths uniformly as diagnostics. Current Nov30 policy not treated as historical policy. Deployment uses each current policy length. Selection uses next-week metric; disclose if longer-horizon ranking differs.
information_limit: Current statuses are final extract values; change timestamps unavailable. Use no status-derived features; comparisons conditional on extract labels, not fully reconstructable historical knowledge. Stockouts cannot be corrected. No independent success claim.
revision_rule: Retain this plan and all results. Any later candidate requires prospective versioned plan; exploratory only. No unbounded search.
